title: gladiolus segetum var. bornetii
intro: Gladiolus segetum var. bornetii, commonly known as the wild gladiolus, is a plant species that belongs to the family Iridaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of the wild gladiolus are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help in wound healing and reducing pain. The bioactive constituents of the plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
